{{Quote|Grievous is out there, sitting on his clanky butt thinking he's got us whipped before we fire a single shot. I'm in the mood to contradict him boys. How about you?|Fireball briefing [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]]|<ref name="Stealth" />}}
'''Fireball''', or "'''Fib'''" for short, was a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who led [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]].

==Biography==
His squadron was based on the [[Indomitable (Republic cruiser)|''Indomitable'']] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]]. He defiantly colored his hair scarlet with a single black streak, yet was committed to his men and to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Before the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle of Kothlis]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]], Skywalker briefed the pilots about the upcoming conflict. Upon hearing the news that communications were jammed, he spoke to his men, inspiring them. During the battle he flew next to Skywalker for a moment, pausing to give a quick smile in response to Skywalker's thumbs-up, and flew off to engage more [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]]. He was one of the pilots to survive the engagement, and hunted down the last of the enemy fighters while his General landed on the surface.<ref name="Stealth" />

A few weeks later, he and his squadron were standing down at a [[Republic Service Organization]] lounge on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He was playing [[turbo-dart]]s with members of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] when Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived to brief them on an upcoming mission. Skywalker and Kenobi had gone [[Battle of Lanteeb|missing]] on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] and a task force was going to rescue them before the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] could release his bioweapon.<ref name="Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>

When the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|flotilla]] arrived over Lanteeb, they found a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of Separatist ships led by General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] waiting for them. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] had provided a captured Separatist spy ship to as a decoy so Jedi Master [[Taria Damsin]] could land and assist Skywalker and Kenobi. Fireball was assigned to "attack" the ship as a ruse, fooling Grievous into letting the ship through the blockade. Fireball was almost hit by a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]], but avoided the blast. Even though Gold Squadron lost almost a quarter of its pilots, the battle was won after a corporate fleet arrived to reinforce the Republic and forced Grievous to flee.<ref name="Siege" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'll take fighting over chitchat anyday.|Fireball claiming his love for fighting|<ref name="Stealth" />}}
He dyed his hair scarlet with a black streak.<ref name="Stealth" /> According to Ahsoka Tano, he was the best pilot in Gold Squadron, next to Skywalker. He also enjoyed playing turbo-darts.<ref name="Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fireball appears in the [[2010]] ''Clone Wars Gambit'' duology.
